changelog:
- Initial release of retail-new-year-pack skill.
- Converts seller-supplied new-year store mood notes into a labeled retail playlist of 8 to 15 original instrumental tracks.
- Defines clear playlist planning, generation, confirmation, and delivery steps, including hard input collection and safe defaults.
- Integrates with the Beatra MCP client for all remote operations and automatic update management.
- Provides references for workflows, billing, updates, and recovery processes.
summary: Turn seller-supplied new-year store mood notes into one retail playlist of 8 to 15 instrumentals. This new year music studio writes a retail playlist and seasonal store BGM set for doors-open, browse, and close. Use it for new year music, retail playlists, and seasonal store BGM.
